decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed two-storey detached dwellinghouse, by reason of its size, design and position within an existing private rear garden, would represent an unacceptable form of backland development, detrimental to the residential amenities of the adjoining properties by reason of enclosure, loss of outlook, overshadowing, loss of privacy and increased noise and disturbance, contrary to Unitary Development Plan (UDP) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1 and H.6.3 (December 2003).

Condition : 2 - The proposed dwellinghouse, by reason of its size, position and appearance, would result in an incongruous and overbearing development, which would be detrimental to the visual amenity of the streetscene, and would not respect the predominant character and density of the area. Furthermore, the proposal would result in the loss of part of a back garden, which currently contributes to the character and nature conservation of the area. The proposal would therefore be contrary to UDP (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1 and H.6.3.

Condition : 3 - The proposed dwellinghouse, by reason of its size, position and layout, would represent an cramped overdevelopment of the site, which would fail to provide the Council's minimum standards for private amenity space for the proposed and existing house, resulting in substandard living conditions, detrimental to the residential amenity of the occupants, and contrary to UDP (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.4.1.

Condition : 4 - The proposed off-street parking provision fails to meet the Council's Parking Standards and would result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies T.1.4 and T 5.3.
description: Erection of a two bedroom detached dwellinghouse with associated parking and landscaping.
